'''Ghomrassen''' was one of the three [[moon]]s of [[Tatooine]], along with [[Guermessa]] and [[Chenini]].<ref name="AbEverything" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In [[2016]], a compilation album titled ''[[Star Wars Headspace]]'' featured a track named "Ghomrassen," which was produced by British musician [[Wikipedia:Bonobo (musician)|Bonobo]].<ref name="Headspace">''[[Star Wars Headspace]]''</ref>
